description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Tholabugolla, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District - (25/0220)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration procedures under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and title classifications, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
